dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君、起きてください」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun, please wake up."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun, please wake up."

dialogues.jp: 周囲のもやから浮きでるような声が耳にとどく。
dialogues.en: A calm voice floated around my ears.
dialogues.text: A calm voice floated around my ears.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、もう起きる時間ですよ〜」
dialogues.en: "C'mon, it's time to get up already~"
dialogues.text: "C'mon, it's time to get up already~"

dialogues.jp: 心地よい、透きとおるような声。
dialogues.en: It felt like a transparent-sounding voice.
dialogues.text: It felt like a transparent-sounding voice.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「もう……本当に起きてないんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Geez... you're really not gonna get up?"
dialogues.text: "Geez... you're really not gonna get up?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「しょうがないですね」
dialogues.en: "Looks like I have no other choice."
dialogues.text: "Looks like I have no other choice."

dialogues.jp: 空気が動き、ことりの気配をすぐ側に感じる。
dialogues.en:
The atmosphere suddenly shifted, and I could feel Kotori
next to me.
dialogues.text:
The atmosphere suddenly shifted, and I could feel Kotori
next to me.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「起きないと、キスしちゃいますよ」
dialogues.en: "If you don't get up, I'm going to kiss you."
dialogues.text: "If you don't get up, I'm going to kiss you."

dialogues.jp:
ささやくことりの吐息が耳にあたり、くすぐっ
たい。
dialogues.en:
I could feel her breath tickling my ears as she whispered
that.
dialogues.text:
I could feel her breath tickling my ears as she whispered
that.

dialogues.jp:
そんなことを言われては、ますます起きるわけ
にはいかなくなる。
dialogues.en: Having heard that, there's no way I'm going to get up now.
dialogues.text: Having heard that, there's no way I'm going to get up now.

dialogues.jp: （男なら当然だろう！）
dialogues.en: "(Of course I wouldn't, I'm a guy after all!)"
dialogues.text: "(Of course I wouldn't, I'm a guy after all!)"

dialogues.jp:
俺はことりの柔らかな感触を余すことなく堪能
するため、全神経を頬に集中する。
dialogues.en:
Waiting for the feeling of Kotori's soft touch, I
concentrated all my sensitivity on my cheek.
dialogues.text:
Waiting for the feeling of Kotori's soft touch, I
concentrated all my sensitivity on my cheek.

dialogues.jp: （いや、唇という可能性も……）
dialogues.en: "(Then again, it could be on the lips...)"
dialogues.text: "(Then again, it could be on the lips...)"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun..."

dialogues.jp: ごくん――。
dialogues.en: *glomph*--
dialogues.text: *glomph*--

dialogues.jp: なかなか、ことりの唇がやってこない。
dialogues.en: That definitely wasn't Kotori's lips.
dialogues.text: That definitely wasn't Kotori's lips.

dialogues.jp: それに、周りのもやが消えたような――。
dialogues.en: And the darkness around me suddenly subsided--
dialogues.text: And the darkness around me suddenly subsided--

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いいかげんに起きろ！　朝倉ッ」
dialogues.en: "Asakura!! Wake up already!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura!! Wake up already!"

dialogues.jp: ガスッ――！！
dialogues.en: --*thwack!**
dialogues.text: --*thwack!**

dialogues.jp: 声にならない声をだす。
dialogues.en: A voice I wasn't expecting rang out.
dialogues.text: A voice I wasn't expecting rang out.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「やっと起きたか……」
dialogues.en: "You finally woke up..."
dialogues.text: "You finally woke up..."

dialogues.jp:
目を開けると、側に暦先生が立ってた。手には、
出席簿をもっている。
dialogues.en:
As I opened my eyes, the figure of Koyomi-sensei filled my
vision. She was holding the attendance record in her hand.
dialogues.text:
As I opened my eyes, the figure of Koyomi-sensei filled my
vision. She was holding the attendance record in her hand.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「もう授業は終わりだぞ。最後ぐらい起きろ」
dialogues.en: "The lesson will be over soon, stay awake until then."
dialogues.text: "The lesson will be over soon, stay awake until then."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、教壇の上に戻る。
dialogues.en: With that, she went back to the front of the classroom.
dialogues.text: With that, she went back to the front of the classroom.

dialogues.jp: （もしかして――｛あれ／出席簿｝で？）
dialogues.en: "(Don't tell me that was... the attendance record I felt?)"
dialogues.text: "(Don't tell me that was... the attendance record I felt?)"

dialogues.jp: ぐおっ――。
dialogues.en: Gwoh--.
dialogues.text: Gwoh--.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、終わるよ。週番、号令」
dialogues.en: "Alright, class's over. Weekly duty, rise."
dialogues.text: "Alright, class's over. Weekly duty, rise."

dialogues.jp: 何事もなかったかのように、授業が終わる。
dialogues.en: With nothing else to announce, the class ended.
dialogues.text: With nothing else to announce, the class ended.

dialogues.jp: 「なんか、散々な目にあったな」
dialogues.en: "Wow, my eyes must look horrible."
dialogues.text: "Wow, my eyes must look horrible."

dialogues.jp: でも、おかげで昼休みを寝過ごさずにすんだ。
dialogues.en: But at least I managed to sleep till noontime.
dialogues.text: But at least I managed to sleep till noontime.

dialogues.jp: せっかくだから、昼飯でも食いに行くか……。
dialogues.en: Guess it's time to get ready for lunch...
dialogues.text: Guess it's time to get ready for lunch...

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりの夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆Dreaming Of Kotori◆
dialogues.text: ◆Dreaming Of Kotori◆

dialogues.jp: ことりの夢を見た。
dialogues.en: I dreamt of Kotori.
dialogues.text: I dreamt of Kotori.

dialogues.jp: ことりが、俺を優しく起こしてくれる夢だ……。
dialogues.en: She was gently waking me up...
dialogues.text: She was gently waking me up...
